courses.title: Grief, Loss, and Renewal: Savoring Life's Lessons
courses.description: A weekend retreat at Kripalu in which Aruni guides people living with grief and loss through mindfulness meditation, body-centred movement and journaling. The sessions use yoga on and off the mat as a way to meet difficult emotions, with daily yoga classes and meals included in the stay.
